query:
SELECT d.id
        FROM "Document" d
        JOIN document_sub_type dst ON dst.document_id = d.id AND dst.sub_type = 'task'
        WHERE d.id = ANY($1)
          AND d."deletedAt" IS NULL
          AND d."projectId" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (
              SELECT "projectId" FROM "Document" WHERE id = $2
          )
        ORDER BY d.id
        FOR UPDATE
